title: NoRedstone
description: Disable redstone components in specific worlds
body:
# NoRedstone

A Minecraft plugin that disables redstone components in specific worlds while keeping rails functional.

## Features

- Disable all redstone components in configured worlds
- Optional rail system control (can be enabled/disabled)
- Observer block blocking included
- Turkish language support
- Simple reload command
- Debug mode for troubleshooting

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.20+
- Paper/Spigot server
- Java 17+

## Installation

1. Download the plugin JAR file
2. Place it in your server's `plugins` folder
3. Restart your server
4. Configure worlds in `config.yml`

## Configuration

Edit `plugins/NoRedstone/config.yml`:

```yaml
disabled-worlds:
  - "world_nether"
  - "world_the_end"

settings:
  enable-rails: true
  debug: false
```

## Commands

- `/noredstone reload` - Reload configuration

## Permissions

- `noredstone.admin` - Access to admin commands

## Blocked Components

- Redstone dust, torches, repeaters, comparators
- Pistons, hoppers, droppers, dispensers
- Observers, pressure plates, buttons
- Note blocks, tripwire hooks
- Powered rails (if rails disabled)
